shell_commands:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: beforeSession hook linting and configuration issues

Fix three issues from the previous round:
- PromptBuilder config used non-existent 'baseSystemPrompt' property; corrected to 'identity'
- Acceptance test had 3 expect calls (max 1 allowed); combined into single assertion
- Duplicate unit test removed to resolve no-duplicate-code linting error
- Add CHANGELOG entry documenting the behavior change

The acceptance test now properly validates that beforeSession throws still reach
onError and afterSession hooks, as required by the acceptance criteria.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main

git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs: move beforeSession error guarantee out of out-of-scope section

Update specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md to document beforeSession error
handling as a guaranteed behavior (owned by #94) rather than as a measured
semantic left out of scope. Creates a new "beforeSession error handling" section
that clearly documents the guarantee: a throw from beforeSession reaches onError
and afterSession hooks, allowing deployers to assume no tools were run.

Mark all three dod.md facets as complete.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
